name: Catalogify – Product Catalogs for WooCommerce
author: byteboys

sections.description:
Turn your WooCommerce store into a print-ready product catalog in minutes. Catalogify generates polished, branded catalogs straight from your existing products — no design tools, no manual layout, no copy-pasting.

Whether you sell direct to consumers or supply resellers and wholesale buyers, a clean catalog does the selling for you. Hand a B2B prospect a structured product list with your branding, email a seasonal lookbook to customers, or print a leaflet for a trade fair — all from the same store data you already maintain.

Three templates, three jobs

  • Minimal — clean, image-forward layout for lifestyle and consumer products
  • Catalogue — classic multi-column layout with table of contents, ideal for larger ranges
  • Product (B2B) — detail-rich layout built for resellers and wholesale, with room for SKUs and specifications

Made for any kind of store

Catalogify works for any WooCommerce shop, whatever you sell:
* Pet supplies — toys, food, and accessories in a clean lookbook
* Fashion & apparel — image-forward seasonal collections and lookbooks
* Golf & sports gear — equipment and accessories with specs side by side
* PC, tech & gadgets — detail-rich product sheets with SKUs and specifications
* Home & living, food & drink, beauty, toys — and anything else in your catalog

You decide the order

Drag and drop products into exactly the sequence you want. Lead with your bestsellers, group items by theme, or follow your own logic — the catalog follows your order, not just whatever WooCommerce returns by default.

What you get

  • Build from all products, a category, or a handpicked selection
  • Drag-and-drop page ordering
  • Automatic table of contents
  • Custom cover image and branding
  • Product badges (new, sale, bestseller, and more)
  • 4 languages included
  • Clean HTML output, ready to print or save as PDF

Built on your own data

Catalogify reads directly from WooCommerce — your products, prices, images, and categories. Update a product in your store and regenerate the catalog; everything stays in sync. No external services, no data leaves your site (catalog templates load Google Fonts for typography — see notes below).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/catalogify-for-woocommerce/
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. WooCommerce must be installed and active
  4. Go to Catalogify in your WordPress admin menu
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Catalogify reads your products directly from WooCommerce.

How do I get a PDF file?

Generate the catalog and use your browser Print function (File > Print > Save as PDF) in Chrome.

Does this plugin connect to any external services?

The catalog templates load Google Fonts from fonts.googleapis.com for typography in the generated HTML. No user data is sent beyond the standard HTTP request to load font files. See Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  • New: expanded template layouts (spotlight and grid refinements across Minimal, Catalogue and Product templates)
  • Improved: catalog generator output and admin interface
  • Improved: badge rendering and table of contents layout
  • Various styling and stability fixes

1.0.0

  • Initial release
